
            <div class="postcontent">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<section id="mp-md" style="-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-autospace: normal; text-align: left; padding: 1em; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.75; word-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在企业信息化流程中，PDF 表单是一种常见的数据采集载体。用户填写完成后，系统往往需要自动提取表单域中的数据，用于入库、校验或后续业务处理。本文将介绍如何使用 C# 读取 PDF 文档中的交互式表单域，覆盖文本框、复选框、单选按钮组、下拉列表等常见字段类型。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">一、方案概述</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">PDF 表单域的每个字段拥有唯一名称、类型标识和当前值。读取表单域的核心思路是：加载 PDF 文档 → 获取表单集合 → 遍历字段 → 根据字段类型提取对应值。</span></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">本文采用 Free Spire.PDF for .NET 免费库来完成读取操作。该库提供了 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">PdfFormWidget</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 类型用于操作 PDF 表单，支持通过索引或字段名定位具体字段。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">二、环境准备</span></h2>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">2.1 安装 NuGet 包</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在 Visual Studio 的 NuGet 包管理器中搜索并安装 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">FreeSpire.PDF</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，或在包管理器控制台执行：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-powershell" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">Install-Package FreeSpire.PDF
</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">安装完成后，项目中会自动添加 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">Spire.Pdf.dll</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 引用。免费版对单个 PDF 文档有10页限制，对于表单读取场景通常足够使用。</span></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">2.2 引入命名空间</span></h3>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> Spire.Pdf;
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> Spire.Pdf.Widget;
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> System;
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> System.Text;
</code></pre>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">三、读取 PDF 表单域的基本流程</span></h2>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">3.1 加载 PDF 文档并获取表单</span></h3>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 创建 PdfDocument 实例并加载 PDF 文件</span>
PdfDocument doc = <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">new</span> PdfDocument();
doc.LoadFromFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"YourForm.pdf"</span>);
</code><p><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 获取文档中的表单（需转换为 PdfFormWidget 类型）</span><br>
PdfFormWidget formWidget = doc.Form <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">as</span> PdfFormWidget;<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">需要注意的是，</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">doc.Form</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 属性返回的是表单对象，但为了访问完整的字段集合，需要将其转换为 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">PdfFormWidget</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 类型</span></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">3.2 遍历所有表单域</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">通过 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">formWidget.FieldsWidget.List</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 可以获取所有表单域的集合：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 遍历所有表单域</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> (<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">int</span> i = <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0</span>; i &lt; formWidget.FieldsWidget.List.Count; i++)
{
    PdfField field = formWidget.FieldsWidget.List[i] <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">as</span> PdfField;
    <span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 获取字段名称</span>
    <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> fieldName = field.Name;
    Console.WriteLine(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">$"字段名称: <span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{fieldName}</span>"</span>);
}
</code></pre>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">四、获取不同类型表单域的值</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">PDF 表单中常见的字段类型包括文本框、复选框、单选按钮、列表框和下拉列表框等。针对不同类型的字段，需要使用不同的属性来获取其值</span></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">4.1 文本框（PdfTextBoxFieldWidget）</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">文本框字段的值存储在 Text 属性中：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> (field <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">is</span> PdfTextBoxFieldWidget)
{
    PdfTextBoxFieldWidget textBoxField = field <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">as</span> PdfTextBoxFieldWidget;
    <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> name = textBoxField.Name;
    <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">value</span> = textBoxField.Text;
    Console.WriteLine(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">$"文本框 - 名称: <span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{name}</span>, 值: <span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">value</span>}</span>"</span>);
}
</code></pre>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">4.2 复选框（PdfCheckBoxWidgetFieldWidget）</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">复选框的选中状态可通过 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">Checked</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 属性判断：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> (field <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">is</span> PdfCheckBoxWidgetFieldWidget)
{
    PdfCheckBoxWidgetFieldWidget checkBoxField = field <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">as</span> PdfCheckBoxWidgetFieldWidget;
    <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> name = checkBoxField.Name;
    <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">bool</span> isChecked = checkBoxField.Checked;
    Console.WriteLine(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">$"复选框 - 名称: <span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{name}</span>, 是否选中: <span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{isChecked}</span>"</span>);
}
</code></pre>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">4.3 单选按钮组（PdfRadioButtonListFieldWidget）</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">单选按钮组中，可通过 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">SelectedValue</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 获取哪个选项被选中：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> (field <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">is</span> PdfRadioButtonListFieldWidget)
{
    PdfRadioButtonListFieldWidget radioBtnField = field <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">as</span> PdfRadioButtonListFieldWidget;
    <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> name = radioBtnField.Name;
    <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> selectedValue = radioBtnField.SelectedValue;
    Console.WriteLine(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">$"单选按钮 - 名称: <span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{name}</span>, 选中值: <span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{selectedValue}</span>"</span>);;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">4.4 列表框（PdfListBoxWidgetFieldWidget）</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">列表框的值包括所有可选项以及当前选中的项：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> (field <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">is</span> PdfListBoxWidgetFieldWidget)
{
    PdfListBoxWidgetFieldWidget listBoxField = field <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">as</span> PdfListBoxWidgetFieldWidget;
    <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> name = listBoxField.Name;
    <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> selectedValue = listBoxField.SelectedValue;
<p>Console.WriteLine(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">$"列表框 - 名称: <span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{name}</span>, 选中值: <span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{selectedValue}</span>"</span>);</p>
</code><p><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 获取所有选项</span><br>
PdfListWidgetItemCollection items = listBoxField.Values;<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">foreach</span> (PdfListWidgetItem item <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> items)<br>
{<br>
Console.WriteLine(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">$"  选项: <span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{item.Value}</span>"</span>);<br>
}<br>
}<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">4.5 下拉列表（PdfComboBoxWidgetFieldWidget）</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">下拉列表框的取值方式与列表框类似：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> (field <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">is</span> PdfComboBoxWidgetFieldWidget)
{
    PdfComboBoxWidgetFieldWidget comboField = field <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">as</span> PdfComboBoxWidgetFieldWidget;
    <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> name = comboField.Name;
    <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> selectedValue = comboField.SelectedValue;
    Console.WriteLine(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">$"下拉列表框 - 名称: <span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{name}</span>, 选中值: <span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{selectedValue}</span>"</span>);
}
</code></pre>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">五、注意事项与常见问题</span></h2>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">5.1 空表单判断</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">并非所有 PDF 都包含表单。如果 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">doc.Form</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 无法转换为 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">PdfFormWidget</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，或 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">FieldsWidget.Count</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 为 0，说明文档不含交互式表单域，此时应走普通文本提取流程。</span></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">5.2 XFA 表单与 AcroForm 表单</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">PDF 表单主要有两种标准：</span></p>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 8px 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">AcroForm</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：Adobe 原生表单标准，也是本文介绍的类型，对应 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">PdfFormWidget</code></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">XFA 表单</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：基于 XML 的表单规范，常见于旧版 Adobe LiveCycle 设计的表单</span></li>
</ul>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">如果遇到 XFA 表单，需要通过 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">formWidget.XFAForm</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 另行处理，字段结构与取值方式完全不同。</span></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">5.3 资源释放</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">处理完 PDF 后，建议调用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">doc.Close()</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 释放资源：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">doc.Close();
</code></pre>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">六、总结</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">读取 PDF 表单域的核心在于正确识别字段类型并调用对应的取值属性。</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">PdfFormWidget</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 提供了统一的字段访问入口，配合 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">as</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 模式匹配进行类型转换，即可覆盖绝大多数 AcroForm 表单的读取需求。</span></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 0; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在实际项目中，建议先通过遍历方式摸清目标 PDF 的字段结构与命名规则，再封装为强类型的数据模型进行业务处理，这样既能保证读取的准确性，也便于后续维护扩展。</span></p></section>

</div>
